searchText: glad you caused the trouble now 😉 keep it coming speaking of hex - since we're all used to it and printing it everywhere, maybe that's what should be in the yaml after all Interestingly beaconcha.in says I've lost nearly 32 ETH - I wonder if it thinks I started with 64ETH because this validator had to make two deposits (one of which was invalid): https://schlesi.beaconcha.in/validator/846af35f93ee70c5a9136a1bcbebcf52afaf931028562466f09f1689632fbbf60f809fd791d0c5dc44b45f1474988683 I mean, it's technically accurate since I did burn 32 ETH but seems somewhat misleading. 🙂 If anyone is interested, these are the bad deposit signatures on schlesi: https://gist.github.com/protolambda/c146b66fb79a836d027ac8f93403ef5f Just 82. On Topaz, there's almost 2k of them. Testnets are for experimentation though, kind of expected, but wouldn't be opposed to more safety measures for deposits. 68 through 170 are bad! Looks like someone did a GregTheGreek. Oh, there are a few gaps, but still... Not desparately surprising, given the moving nature of BLS. Once we pick one and stick to it things should be a lot easier (plus if the next eth1 hardfork goes in we could do on-chain verification)
